content.value_statement: International expansion requires market, logistics, tax, payment, and localization choices. This skill turns seller context into ranked markets, landed-cost analysis, and a phased launch roadmap.
actual_capabilities: Scores target markets across market size, penetration, competition, regulation, logistics, payments, culture, and IP protection.
Compares direct shipping, local 3PL, platform fulfillment, dropshipping, and consolidation models.
Summarizes VAT, GST, sales tax, duty, customs, and registration considerations for major markets.
Maps payment preferences and gateway options for regions such as the EU, UK, Japan, Brazil, India, and Australia.
Builds phased launch roadmaps with setup tasks, milestones, KPIs, and budget estimates.
Creates landed-cost and margin analysis using user-provided product, shipping, tax, and return assumptions.
limitations: It provides planning guidance, not legal, tax, or customs advice.
Regulatory rates and thresholds may change and require current local verification.
Shipping and payment estimates are directional until the user supplies quotes and live transaction data.
It does not connect to stores, carriers, marketplaces, or tax systems by itself.

use_cases.title: Choose First Expansion Market
use_cases.description: Compare nearby markets, estimate launch complexity, and select a first international target with practical next steps.

use_cases.title: Fix Cross-Border Margins
use_cases.description: Break down landed costs, duties, shipping, payment fees, and returns to identify margin leaks by country.

use_cases.title: Build Multi-Market Roadmap
use_cases.description: Create a phased launch plan across several countries with compliance tasks, fulfillment choices, KPIs, and milestones.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner Market Recommendation
prompt_templates.scenario: A seller wants a first international market.
prompt_templates.prompt: I sell [product] on [platform] in [home market] with about [monthly revenue]. Recommend the best first international markets and explain the tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Fulfillment Model Comparison
prompt_templates.scenario: A seller needs logistics options before launch.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare direct shipping, 3PL, marketplace fulfillment, dropshipping, and consolidation for selling [product] from [origin] to [target countries]. Include cost drivers and transit tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Tax and Duty Readiness Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review tax, duty, customs, product compliance, and payment requirements for selling [product category] into [countries]. Flag what needs expert verification.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced Expansion Roadmap
prompt_templates.scenario: An operator needs a detailed execution plan.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a 12-month cross-border roadmap for [brand] expanding from [current markets] to [target markets]. Include scorecards, landed costs, fulfillment, payments, localization, budget, KPIs, and decision gates.

output_examples.input: A Shopify seller in the United States wants to expand pet accessories into Canada and the UK.
output_examples.output: The skill produces a ranked market recommendation, compares direct shipping with local 3PL options, lists VAT and GST checkpoints, and gives a phased launch plan.

output_examples.input: An Amazon seller wants to know why a small electronics product loses margin in EU orders.
output_examples.output: The skill breaks down landed cost, duty, VAT, payment fees, shipping, returns, and FX impact, then suggests pricing and fulfillment changes.

output_examples.input: An operations lead needs a launch checklist for Germany, Japan, and Australia.
output_examples.output: The skill creates market scorecards, compliance checkpoints, payment recommendations, localization tasks, milestone timing, and KPI targets for each market.

best_practices: Provide product category, weight, dimensions, origin country, current margin, and monthly order volume.
Ask the skill to separate estimated benchmarks from verified company data.
Validate tax, customs, product compliance, and registration steps with qualified local advisors before launch.
anti_patterns: Do not treat the output as final legal, customs, or tax advice.
Do not launch a country before confirming landed costs and return handling.
Do not copy domestic pricing, payment methods, or product pages into every market without localization.

faq.question: Does this skill require an API key?
faq.answer: No. The skill works from the user context and its built-in planning framework.

faq.question: Can it choose which country to enter first?
faq.answer: Yes. It scores markets across eight dimensions and explains the ranking assumptions.

faq.question: Does it calculate exact duties and taxes?
faq.answer: It provides a structured estimate framework. Exact filings and rates require current verification by qualified professionals.

faq.question: Which platforms does it support?
faq.answer: It covers planning for Amazon, Shopify, WooCommerce, Walmart, TikTok Shop, Etsy, eBay, BigCommerce, and multi-channel sellers.

faq.question: Can it compare fulfillment options?
faq.answer: Yes. It compares direct shipping, local 3PL, platform fulfillment, dropshipping, and consolidation models.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compatible workflows.
